title: Capstone RBAC Server — Startup & Audit Log
caption: A centralized RBAC and identity server built with a five-person capstone team: RS256-signed JWTs carrying roles and permissions, validated end-to-end from login through a downstream service.
alt: Terminal output from docker compose up: the Postgres database initializing its schema and seed data and reporting healthy, the auth engine warning that no private key file was found so it falls back to a temporary in-memory RS256 key, the Core Authentication Engine starting on port 8080, the downstream mock service delegating authorization checks to it, and audit log lines showing a login and a token validation both granted to the admin role.

title: AWS Cloud Resume — S3 Bucket
caption: The S3 bucket this site deploys to, showing the actual build output: 404 page, blog and resume folders, sitemaps, and the Astro built index.html, all served through CloudFront.
alt: AWS S3 console showing the carsonfarinella.com bucket's root objects: 404.html, blog/, favicon.ico, favicon.svg, gallery/, images/, index.html, resume/, scripts/, sitemap-0.xml, sitemap-index.xml, and workbench/ — the actual build output this site deploys from.

title: Before & After — Moving to Astro
caption: Retiring the hand-rolled static site for a real build pipeline: git push triggers a GitHub Actions Astro build, deploying only the build output to S3 behind CloudFront.
alt: GitHub Actions run for the Deploy Resume Website workflow, showing every step succeeding — checkout, Node setup, dependency install, Astro build, AWS credential configuration, sync to S3, CloudFront invalidation, and a Cloudflare cache purge — completing in 24 seconds.
